description: Additive Go Giztest peer_stream result/evidence fields. All offsets are fractional milliseconds on one task's shared Go monotonic clock. Receive samples require the exact marked first nonempty input packet and a successful Push; missing delivery is an empty array, never zero latency.

send_start_ms.description: Immediately before Push of the first nonempty Opus packet, after PTT hold and audio-route acknowledgement.

send_completed_ms.description: After that packet's Push succeeds; a local write boundary, not a hardware wire timestamp.

startup_ms.description: From the sender invocation before stream opening to send_start_ms; includes actual startup/hold/route wait.

receive_ms.description: Immediately after PeerStream.Next returns this exact SFU packet, before audio decoding or operation-loop queueing.

latency_ms.description: receive_ms minus send_start_ms. Includes SDK, uplink, Server/SFU/LiveKit and downlink; excludes startup_ms. Not pure LiveKit processing or speaker playback latency.
